# Sandane Homes
> Residences by Sandane Homes finds, leases, furnishes and manages homes for expat and corporate employees in Gurugram (Gurgaon), Noida and Greater Noida, on demand. Sandane Homes also runs boutique hotels in Greater Noida for short stays.

## Residences by Sandane Homes
- On demand: we do not own the homes. We find a 3–4 BHK home near where the employee will work, lease it, furnish and set it up, and manage it for the whole stay.
- Cities served: Gurugram, Noida and Greater Noida.
- Minimum stay: 30 days, then month by month.
- Company lease, with one monthly GST invoice to the company. The employee pays no rent and signs no lease.
- Included: the furnished 3–4 BHK home with kitchenware and linen, housekeeping, Wi-Fi, 100% power backup, utilities and maintenance.
- No prices are published; quotes depend on the home, the dates and the services.
